notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed many bugs and improved performance.

Resolved an issue where the game would freeze during crashes or when closing.

⚠️ Known Issue: In rare cases, the game may still freeze during loading screens. We're continuing to investigate this.
